notes.title: No Trailer, No Release, Big Issue!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

We were on track for the Early Access release of Exist, although we were told yesterday we need a trailer! No trailer, no release, apparently. Don't worry. We’re on that and getting it done. It will take some time, but we will try our best to get it out so you can give Exist a go as soon as possible. If you would like to help us capture content in-game for the trailer, let us know, it would be much appreciated.


We planned to get a trailer done a while ago, but we forgot about it as time went on and put it on the bottom of the priority pile since then. Whoops


Thank you all for your support and understanding.
[b]- BullBox Studios Team[/b]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]Happy New Year![/h1][/h2]
 
We are happy to report that our progress on Exist has been ramped up in recent weeks and we expect to release on time. (Feb 18th)

Covid impacted our jobs outside of developing Exist, which increased workflow giving us little time to work on the project. However, it has since decreased in flow in the past few weeks giving us more time to work on Exist. Due to this Experience, we at BullBox Studios are taking full advantage of this time.

We know 2020 has been a rough year, But here’s to making 2021 a good one!

notes.title: Information about the delay
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

We apologise for not talking about this delay sooner.

We want to take a moment to discuss the recent delay in short. We didn't think Exist was good enough for its current release date 17th February, it just did not have enough content, and many things still need to be done on Exist. Thinking it was too bland for release, we wouldn't like to release unfinished stuff because we don't want to disappoint you. We have no set release date as of yet, but we are looking at getting Exist out a soon as we think it's ready.

 
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to discuss it below or join our new official Discord, and directly talk about it with the community and the team.

[url=https://discord.gg/QShbvMb]BullBox Studios Official Discord link[/url]


Also, keep an eye out on our Youtube channel. We will be posting an Exist Trailer soon!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtZSaCVL_h1wKjFfsSdSqWg]BullBox Studios Official Youtube Channel[/url] (no Content on the channel yet lmao)


Thanks!
